svg.title: Architecture of the Weight-Space Atlas
svg.desc: Five layers: typed content in src/content, build-time scripts, React renderers, 26 static routes in the Next.js App Router, and a static export deployed to Vercel, Netlify or GitHub Pages.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Content is data. Components render it. Next.js exports it as static HTML.
